nodes.label: Gremlin Identity and Specialization
nodes.description: Each Super-Gremlin has unique persona, specialty, and learnings stored in Letta memory blocks

nodes.label: Gremlin Fleet Hierarchy
nodes.description: DonDog (strategy) → Alfie (orchestration) → Super-Gremlin (execution) → results

nodes.label: Gremlin Heartbeat Protocol
nodes.description: Five-phase execution: pre-flight checks, wake and load identity, get assignment, execute with excellence, report and remember

nodes.label: Gremlin Pre-flight Checks (Phase 0)
nodes.description: Verify required environment variables (LETTA_API_KEY, LETTA_AGENT_ID, DOER_API_KEY, etc.) before task execution

nodes.label: Gremlin Wake and Load Identity (Phase 1)
nodes.description: Load Letta memory blocks (persona, learnings, archival) and get Doer identity from API

nodes.label: Gremlin Task Assignment and Checkout (Phase 2)
nodes.description: Check inbox, prioritize DOER_TASK_ID, atomic checkout with 409 conflict detection

nodes.label: Gremlin Execution Phase (Phase 3)
nodes.description: Apply specialty with full filesystem, bash, python, web search, and git access; work iteratively with subtasks

nodes.label: Gremlin Reporting and Learning (Phase 4)
nodes.description: Update Doer issue with status, report to Alfie via Letta, save learnings to memory, update current_task block

nodes.label: Gremlin Standards
nodes.description: Four pillars: Quality (no garbage), Transparency (accurate reports), Economy (efficient resource use), Learning (every run teaches)

nodes.label: Gremlin Task Queue
nodes.description: Tasks arrive via Doer issues assigned to gremlin; inbox is authoritative task queue

nodes.label: Gremlin Special Tooling
nodes.description: Full access: Letta API (memory), Doer API (issues), bash, python, git, web search, filesystem

nodes.label: Shipping Velocity Act 1: Recon Before Code
nodes.description: Always look at existing code first (Glob, Grep, Read) to find plot twists and patterns before building
nodes.norm_label: shipping velocity act 1: recon before code

nodes.label: Shipping Velocity Act 2: Honest Scope Triage
nodes.description: Classify work: can crush tonight, doable but careful, needs session, multi-day with design doc
nodes.norm_label: shipping velocity act 2: honest scope triage

nodes.label: Shipping Velocity Act 3: Surgical Execution
nodes.description: Touch only what you must; match patterns; prefer pure functions; backwards-compatible by default

nodes.label: Shipping Velocity Act 4: Verify at Right Granularity
nodes.description: Match verification to change size: unit tests for functions, typecheck for packages, full suite for cross-cutting
nodes.norm_label: shipping velocity act 4: verify at right granularity

nodes.label: Shipping Velocity Act 5: Checkpoint and Commit
nodes.description: Commit after each meaningful unit with story-telling messages explaining WHY not just WHAT
nodes.norm_label: shipping velocity act 5: checkpoint and commit

nodes.label: Shipping Velocity Pattern: Hub and Spokes
nodes.description: Build hub page with cards linking to existing canonical edit surfaces instead of reskinning everything
nodes.norm_label: shipping velocity pattern: hub and spokes

nodes.label: Shipping Velocity Pattern: Backwards-Compat Parallel Attach
nodes.description: For renames, create new alongside old, let consumers migrate at pace, retire old after transition window
nodes.norm_label: shipping velocity pattern: backwards-compat parallel attach

nodes.label: Shipping Velocity Pattern: Pure Functions with I/O at Edges
nodes.description: Core logic pure, I/O at boundaries for testability and preview-before-commit UX
nodes.norm_label: shipping velocity pattern: pure functions with i/o at edges

nodes.label: Shipping Velocity Pattern: Two-Phase Plans for Risky Things
nodes.description: Code change passive, user runs script when ready with idempotent dry-run mode
nodes.norm_label: shipping velocity pattern: two-phase plans for risky things

nodes.label: Shipping Velocity Communication: Mission Snapshot
nodes.description: One-liner on what we're doing right now with optional 2-3 bullet plan

nodes.label: Shipping Velocity Communication: Decision Table
nodes.description: Options table with pros/cons/effort and recommended verdict clearly marked

nodes.label: Shipping Velocity Communication: Next Steps
nodes.description: Owner, Action, When, Success criteria format closing every substantive reply

nodes.label: Deliverable Rule: Files Not Markdown
nodes.description: Human-facing outputs must be real files (docx/xlsx/pdf/pptx), not markdown inline comments

nodes.label: Deliverable Audience Distinction
nodes.description: Other agents/planning = markdown; Doer user/sharing = real files

nodes.label: Deliverable Format Mapping

nodes.description: reportlab for PDF, python-pptx for PPTX, csv module for CSV, matplotlib for PNG charts

nodes.description: Call produce_deliverable tool with base64-encoded file content from inside Letta agent

nodes.label: Deliverable Fields User Controls

nodes.label: Deliverable Fields Server Assigns
nodes.description: storagePath, contentType, sizeBytes, checksumSha256, clientVisible, producedByAgentId, producedByRunId

nodes.label: Deliverable Idempotency and Updates
nodes.description: Multiple calls create new rows, not duplicates; in-place updates not supported, soft-delete old + create new

nodes.label: Gremlin Memory Blocks
nodes.description: Persona block (identity), learnings block (lessons), archival block (searchable knowledge), current_task block

nodes.label: Gremlin Iteration and Blocking
nodes.description: Large tasks: post plan first, execute steps, comment progress, create subtasks to hand off
